- Barack Obama: born August 4, 1961. As of Oct 30, 2025, age 64 (turned 64 Aug 2025). So 64.

- George W. Bush: born July 6, 1946. As of Oct 30, 2025, age 79 (turned 79 July 2025). So 79.

- Bill Clinton: born August 19, 1946. As of Oct 30, 2025, age 79 (turned 79 Aug 2025). So 79.

Note three are 79. Check dates: Bill Clinton born Aug 19 1946 -> age 79. Yes.

We can also include ages at inauguration if needed, but likely current ages.

We should verify quickly via a lookup.

4. If the birthday had not yet occurred (as with Joe Biden), the age is **(2025 − birth year − 1)**.
